snippet.title: Lootbane - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Lootbane is a minimalistic RPG of risk and reward where insatiable greed drives every decision. Explore shifting regions, build synergistic warbands, and descend into dangerous dungeons for legendary loot. Get another look at Lootbane in this latest trailer. Lootbane will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
